description: Portrait of O'Keeffe wearing a black wrap dress, elbows on table with hands folded and hair pulled back in a bun, sitting at a table for set for breakfast at her Abiquiu House.  On the table are various white bowls, a white coffee cup and saucer, eggs, a Chemex glass coffee carafe, behind her are sun filled French doors and a large potted plant.
title: O'Keeffe at Breakfast
